claims.finding: Insiders sold into the melt-up: Form 144 notices on 2026-08-13, 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-19 with Form 4s on 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-19 - three intents-to-sell inside seven days - during exactly the run that took the stock 30.1% higher over twenty sessions to within 5.5% of its 52-week high, and there is no offsetting purchase anywhere in the index.
claims.corpus_ref: filings.json, Form 144 entries dated 2026-08-19, 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-13 and Form 4 entries dated 2026-08-19 and 2026-08-14
claims.why_not_priced: Form 144s are not indexed by any consumer aggregator, and the retail stream captured on the morning of the print - dozens of messages - never mentions insider selling once; it discusses only the short interest and how far the stock goes after hours. If the market had priced insiders exiting into the rally, the run-in would not be +30% and the stream would not read 'SNOW 2.0 today AH'.
claims.independence: The 30.1% twenty-session run-up and the 66.2m-share average daily volume come from the baseline tape rather than from any captured document, which makes the positioning half of this finding independently verifiable - but no second corpus document points the same way, so treat the insider half as single-sourced.

claims.finding: The print is arriving with the bar reset upward on the day itself: Needham raised its price target to $22.00 on the morning of 2026-09-03, the Estimize crowd sits $0.03 above Wall Street on EPS and $8.48m above on revenue, and a corpus item states 'institutional desks are monitoring this print with high intent to see if their new Agentic AI layer can drive a massive ARR beat' - so the requirement is an ARR acceleration, not a beat.

claims.why_not_priced: This is mostly priced, and I include it signed negative for one reason: a target raise on the morning of the print and a crowd consensus above the sell-side are both symptoms of expectation stacking, and the same corpus records short interest at 26% - which means a merely good print gets sold by the longs before the shorts are forced to cover.
